traits.name: exact
traits.reason: Both lines carry measured numbers (6 legs, 20 wood, 9 legs), but they are counts of work done, not chart tiles or soundings.

traits.name: patient
traits.reason: Gathering and steady moves suggest routine work, but no bridge or pier is actually being built, so there is no evidence of tile-by-tile progress.

traits.name: far going
traits.reason: Moves between several coordinates (94,89), (102,90), (97,100), (98,100) and walked many legs, suggesting some range, but no waypoints are named.

traits.name: open handed
traits.reason: No works are announced or falsely promised, which is good, but there is no evidence of a standing bridge opened to residents.

traits.name: dry
traits.reason: The lines are plain status reports with no sailor's understatement or navy joke.
